verdict.rationale: AvaTax's docs describe API-driven tax calculation, transaction recording, and nexus lookups, but there is no evidence of a user-configurable rules/automation engine that lets a user define 'on event X trigger action Y' logic; in fact docs explicitly state AvaTax handles tax scenarios 'without building custom rule engines' (avalara-docs-14), implying no exposed rule-authoring capability. No evidence of webhooks, triggers, or conditional automation workflows exists in the pack.
